title: Olu of Warri, restored
by: the Itsekiri royal family, under colonial rule
text: After Olu Akengbuwa died in 1848 the Itsekiri had no Olu for 88 years, while merchant-governors ruled the trading rivers and the British took control. The monarchy was restored under colonial rule in 1936, when Ginuwa II, Akengbuwa’s grandson, was installed.
